title: 📊 Nifty 50 Live Dashboard + ATM Options Signals
author: math_6924

comments.author: math_6924
comments.body:
Strategy: 📊
Wait for the market to stay neutral for 5–10 minutes. ⏳
When Net Bias crosses above +10 → Buy CE 🟢📈
When Net Bias crosses below –10 → Buy PE 🔴📉
Additional Condition (Long Momentum):
When bullish stocks tend to 0 and bearish stocks increase by more than 20 → Buy PE 🔴📉
Vice versa: When bearish stocks tend to 0 and bullish stocks increase by more than 20 → Buy CE 🟢📈
Hold the position for a couple of minutes and exit with whatever profit is available. 💰✅
